title: many safes
tagline: deploy the Gnosis Safe (v1.3) contracts on many networks for free
description: we have created a dapp where users can create gnosis safes on multiple networks at once (networks include gnosis chain, optimism, polygon). user signs in with wallet connect to import their account and then they can start using our app. we are also using tenderly to track when the safe is created on each network and we will show the user a link to their safe on each network they select.
how_its_made: - we are using gnosis safe sdks to do things related to the safe (e.g. create the raw tx), we are using rainbow kit to easily connect to user's wallet because it has wallet connect, we are using alchemy to connect to nodes on different networks (e.g. polygon, optimism, and eth). for gnosis chain, we found an rpc endpoint online that we are using for now, we are also using @tenderly/actions to listen for addresses once they are deployed; we show this on the success page to prove to user that these are all the same addresses once they are deploy on different networks.
